how_to_edit: Each shelf shows its perfumes in this order. To add a perfume, find it on the site, open its page, and copy the number at the end of the address (for Khamrah the address ends in #p/75805, so the number is 75805). Add or remove numbers in 'ids', keep the commas between them, then upload this file again. You can add more shelves by copying a whole { ... } block.
